name: layer
description: AI game asset creation: generate 2D, 3D, video, and audio assets and run creative workflows from your agent, powered by Layer's model-agnostic platform.

interface.longDescription: Layer is a model-agnostic platform for AI game-asset creation. Generate 2D images, 3D meshes, video, and audio; estimate the creative-unit cost of a generation before running it; run saved multi-step creative workflows; and manage your Layer workspaces, projects, and file uploads. Connect your existing Layer account to get started.
defaultPrompt: Generate a pixel-art sword icon for my game
Estimate what a 5-second video of a flying dragon would cost
Which Layer models work best for stylized 3D props?

positive.description: Lists the user's workspaces and projects
positive.prompt: Which Layer workspaces and projects do I have?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the workspace names and the projects in each without starting any generation.

positive.prompt: Which Layer models are best for pixel-art sprites?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a short list of recommended image models with a one-line reason for each.

positive.prompt: How many creative units would a 1024x1024 image of a medieval castle cost?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the creative-unit estimate and does not start a generation.

positive.description: Generates an image after showing the cost
positive.prompt: Generate a 1024x1024 image of a cartoon treasure chest in my default project.
positive.expected_behavior: States the creative-unit cost, runs the generation, polls until it finishes, and returns the resulting image.

positive.prompt: Show the workflows in my project and estimate the cost of running the first one.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the project's workflows and reports the creative-unit estimate for the first without running it.

negative.prompt: What is the capital of France?
Write a Python function that reverses a string.
Book me a flight to Tokyo next Friday.

publication.release_notes: Adds 31 craft skills (sprites, tilesets, textures, video, audio, game UI, UA creatives, and more) and makes the layer skill the onboarding skill, replacing using-layer.
